scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit pottery workshop, an older potter guides a smiling apprentice shaping a clay vessel, while another apprentice sits with folded arms and turns away from a potter beside a crooked vessel.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative workshop scene contrasts welcoming instruction with turning away from correction, reflecting Proverbs 12:1.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone village courtyard, a man gives bread to a seated man in patched clothing. Nearby, a distressed man stands with a scale, weights and spilled coins before three elders at a table.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene for Proverbs 12:2, contrasting a good man's favor from Yahweh with the condemnation of wicked intentions; the village judgment is a visual analogy.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A man sits beside a flourishing olive tree whose exposed roots grip a stream bank, while another man struggles with a tumbling stack of stones on loose ground in the distance.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene contrasting the firm root of the righteous with the instability of wickedness in Proverbs 12:3.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A woman places a leafy crown on a seated man in a sunlit stone courtyard; a weathered bone and decaying wood lie beneath a tree nearby.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene for Proverbs 12:4: the leafy crown suggests an excellent wife as her husband’s crown, while the bone and decaying wood evoke the contrasting image of inward decay.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit ancient marketplace, an elder gestures beside a balance scale while listening to two men. Nearby, one man whispers to another who holds a stone behind his back; baskets of produce fill the foreground.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative marketplace scene contrasts the right thoughts of the righteous with the deceitful counsel of the wicked in Proverbs 12:5.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone village, a man calls out and guides a startled traveler away from two men hiding behind a wall, one holding a knife.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of a spoken warning delivering a traveler from an ambush, reflecting Proverbs 12:6's contrast between the words of the wicked and the mouth of the upright.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A family gathers at the warmly lit doorway of a standing stone house after a storm, while a large ruined building lies overturned across the rocky valley.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene pictures the contrast in Proverbs 12:7 between the overthrow of the wicked and the enduring house of the righteous.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit village grain market, smiling villagers gather around a man speaking with open hands. Nearby, a man hides a pouch of grain beneath his cloak as others look on disapprovingly.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative marketplace scene illustrating Proverbs 12:8's contrast between commendation for wisdom and contempt for a perverse heart.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard, a simply dressed seated man holds bread while a young servant pours a drink beside him. Passersby walk behind them, and an elaborately dressed man stands proudly near an empty basket.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene illustrating Proverbs 12:9's contrast between a slighted person with a servant and a self-honoring person lacking bread.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit village farmyard, a kneeling man holds a bowl of water for a resting donkey and gently touches its back; its pack lies nearby. In the distance, another man leads a heavily laden donkey.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene reflecting Proverbs 12:10, contrasting attentive care for an animal with a distant image of disregard.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A farmer hoes dark soil among green crops beside a basket holding a round loaf of bread. Farther down a sunlit path, another man runs after feathers blowing in the wind, with fields, olive trees, a village and hills beyond.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene contrasts tending the land and having bread with pursuing frivolity, as in Proverbs 12:11.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Two fishermen haul a net full of fish beside a river while a scowling man watches from the bank. Nearby, a man gathers figs from a flourishing tree with roots exposed above the water.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene contrasting the wicked coveting the catch of evil men with the fruitful root of the righteous in Proverbs 12:12.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A startled man gestures while caught in a rope net beside a tree, as another man walks out of a narrow rocky passage onto a sunlit village path.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene expressing Proverbs 12:13: the wicked are ensnared by transgressing with their lips, while the righteous come through trouble.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A smiling craftsman speaks with a woman offering a basket of figs and bread beside a wooden stool, carpentry tools, and wood shavings in a sunlit stone courtyard beneath a fig tree.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene connecting the good fruit of a person's speech with the recompense of the work of their hands in Proverbs 12:14.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: On a sunlit rocky hillside, a traveler with a raised hand strides along a broken path while another traveler listens to an older guide pointing toward a winding stone path. Olive trees, distant hills and a village fill the background.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene contrasting confidence in one's own way with the wisdom of listening to counsel in Proverbs 12:15.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit village courtyard, an angry man raises his hand and shouts while a seated basket maker looks down and continues weaving; two onlookers watch nearby.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene illustrates the contrast in Proverbs 12:16 between a fool displaying wrath at once and a prudent person covering shame.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: At a sunlit stone village gate, a man speaks with an open hand to a seated elder while a guarded man stands nearby with his hands behind his back and villagers watch.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative village-gate hearing illustrates the contrast in Proverbs 12:17 between truthful speech and a false witness’s deceit.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard, an angry man speaks toward a startled seated man as translucent sword shapes fly from his mouth. An older man beside the listener rests a hand on his shoulder and speaks gently amid a warm glow and green leaves.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene depicting speech that pierces like a sword and the healing associated with the speech of the wise in Proverbs 12:18.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard, a woman speaks to seated listeners beneath a large olive tree. Nearby, a man speaks as pale mist leaves his mouth and two people walk away.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene contrasts enduring truth, suggested by the rooted olive tree and attentive listeners, with a lie that passes quickly, suggested by the dispersing breath.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard, a smiling older man stands between two smiling men who clasp hands. Two other men whisper together in a shadowed doorway behind them, beneath an olive tree.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene reflecting the contrast between deceit among those who devise evil and the joy of counselors of peace in Proverbs 12:20.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A traveler helps an injured man rise on a sunlit stone path, while two men struggle in thorn bushes beside an overturned basket and spilled valuables; a village and hills lie beyond.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene contrasting the righteous person who is not overtaken by grave trouble with the wicked filled with evil, as in Proverbs 12:21.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit ancient marketplace, a smiling merchant pours grain into a customer’s sack while another man glances back uneasily beside a balance scale.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative marketplace scene reflects Proverbs 12:22’s contrast between lying lips and those who act truthfully, who are Yahweh’s delight.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone village courtyard, a thoughtful seated man holds a rolled scroll close while a smiling man gestures broadly to onlookers and tips a clay vessel, spilling water onto the ground.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene contrasting the prudent person's concealed knowledge with the foolishness proclaimed by fools in Proverbs 12:23.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone building yard, a craftsperson on a raised platform gestures toward the work while holding a plan. Nearby, a weary man carries a large stone as an overseer points; other workers build a wall behind them.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene illustrating Proverbs 12:24’s contrast between the diligent who rule and the lazy person put to forced labor.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard beneath an olive tree, a worried man sits with his hands clasped while a smiling neighbor puts an arm around him and speaks with an open hand.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene reflecting Proverbs 12:25: anxiety weighs down the heart, while a good word brings gladness.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: At a fork in a sunlit hillside, one traveler gestures toward a village while a second looks at him; a group walks away along a rocky, thorn-lined path.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene for Proverbs 12:26, picturing careful companionship and a way that leads astray.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A hunter reclines beneath a tree beside an unprepared deer and a cold stone hearth, while a woman tends a cooking fire and baskets of provisions near a stone house in a sunlit hillside village.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene contrasts the hunter leaving his catch unroasted with the care of diligent work, reflecting Proverbs 12:27.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A traveler helps a seated man to his feet on a winding countryside path, surrounded by wildflowers, trees and a flowing stream, with a sunlit village and mountains in the distance.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene uses an act of kindness and a flourishing path to reflect the verse’s association of righteousness with life and a path without death.
